# CDL Marketing

> CDL Marketing is a flooring marketing agency, part of CDL Management in Kirksville, Missouri. We own and run flooring showrooms ourselves, and we do marketing for flooring stores and flooring companies across the United States: flooring SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profiles, flooring website design, Google and Facebook ads, and AI search visibility (GEO). Marketing is month-to-month: if we don't do what we say, clients can let us go.

CDL Marketing also does marketing for independent restoration companies (water, fire and mold): SEO, Google Ads, Local Services Ads, websites and AI search. CDL Management owns and runs a restoration company as well. See https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/.

Contact: (217) 217-1705, caleb@cdl1.net. Founder: Caleb Foglesong.

## Services
- [Marketing for Flooring Stores | Flooring Marketing Agency | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/): Marketing for flooring stores from a team that runs flooring showrooms: websites, local SEO, Google and Facebook ads and AI search. Month to month.
- [Flooring Websites & Website Design for Flooring Stores | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/websites/): Flooring showroom website design with clear product pages, installation information and inquiry paths. Review the proposed build, monthly care and pricing.
- [SEO for Flooring Companies | Flooring Store SEO | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/local-seo/): SEO for flooring companies and showrooms: Google Business Profile, product and town pages, reviews and listings, reviewed against calls and sold jobs.
- [Flooring Ads: Google & Facebook Ads for Flooring Stores | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/paid-ads/): Google Ads for flooring stores, plus Facebook and Instagram, with matching landing pages and tracked calls. Management fee quoted, ad budget paid direct.
- [AI Search & GEO for Flooring Stores: ChatGPT, Google AI | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/ai-search/): Practical SEO, AEO and GEO work for flooring showrooms: accurate store facts, useful answers and documented AI-search observations. See the process and scope.
- [Flooring Marketing Services | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/): Websites, local SEO, Google and Meta ads, and AI search visibility for independent flooring showrooms. Agree on the work your store needs.
- [Flooring Website & Marketing Pricing | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/pricing/): Proposed website-only plan: $500/month + $1,500 one-time setup. Marketing services and media are separate. Review scope, care and terms before committing.
- [Assisted Living Marketing | Senior Living Marketing Agency | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/assisted-living/): Assisted living marketing for independent homes: websites, local search, reviews and ads, month to month, from people who run an assisted living home too.

## Guides and research
- [Flooring Marketing: A Practical Guide for Flooring Stores](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/marketing-for-flooring-stores/): Flooring marketing in the order that works: Google Business Profile, a fast site, local SEO, reviews, ads and tracking sold jobs. From showroom operators.
- [We tested 831 flooring store websites on a phone](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-website-speed-study/): We ran Google's phone speed test on 831 independent flooring store websites in 49 states. One in ten scored in the good range. The data and what to fix first.
- [Assisted Living Marketing Ideas, and a Simple Plan to Use Them](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/assisted-living-marketing-ideas/): 15 practical assisted living marketing ideas for small independent homes, a simple 90-day plan, and how to judge it by inquiries, tours and move-ins.
- [Assisted Living SEO: A Practical Checklist for Independent Homes](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/assisted-living-seo/): Assisted living SEO for small independent homes: Business Profile, reviews, care and town pages, cost, directories, and tracking calls, tours and move-ins.
- [Broadlume Alternatives for Independent Flooring Stores](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/broadlume-alternatives/): Looking at Broadlume alternatives? The real options for an independent flooring store, how each provider describes itself, and what to check before you switch.
- [Facebook Ads for Flooring Stores: What Works, What to Skip](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/facebook-ads-for-flooring-stores/): How flooring stores should use Facebook and Instagram (Meta) ads: who sees them, what to show, lead form or website, financing rules and how to judge them.
- [Flooring CRM: What It Is, What It Needs and How to Use It](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-crm/): What a flooring CRM is, what it should include, how a showroom uses it day to day, and how it shows what your marketing spend is really producing.
- [Flooring Leads: How to Get More Without Buying Shared Leads](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-leads/): How a flooring store gets more leads: fix what loses them, then add search ads and local SEO. What to ask before buying flooring leads, and how to price a lead.
- [How a flooring store should track phone calls: the setup we use](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-call-tracking/): How to track phone calls at a flooring store: one number per channel, every call logged and graded, each lead tied to a sold job. From our own showrooms.
- [How flooring stores can show up in ChatGPT and AI search](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-chatgpt-ai-search/): A suggested AI-search observation method for flooring stores, useful website and listing checks, and the limits of visibility measurement.
- [What a flooring store website should have: the checklist we use](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-website-checklist/): What a flooring store website should have: a site you control, real photos, plain pricing, guide pages, store data and tracked calls. From showroom operators.
- [Google Ads for flooring stores: what we check in our own accounts](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/google-ads-for-flooring-stores/): How to run Google Ads for a flooring store: count real leads, block searches that never buy, send clicks to the right page and judge by sold jobs.
- [Google Business Profile for flooring stores: a practical checklist](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/google-business-profile-for-flooring-stores/): A practical Business Profile checklist for flooring stores: accurate categories, services, hours, contact paths and measurement with clear limits.
- [Local SEO for flooring stores: a showroom operator checklist](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/local-seo-for-flooring-stores/): Practical local SEO guidance for flooring stores: accurate profiles, useful showroom pages, website access, customer questions and measurement limits.
- [Senior Living Marketing: A Practical Guide for Independent Homes](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/senior-living-marketing/): Senior living marketing for independent assisted living and memory care homes: what to fix first, where move-ins come from and how to judge the spend.
- [Senior Living Website Design: What an Assisted Living Website Needs](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/senior-living-website-design/): Senior living website design for small homes: the first screen families need, pages to build, pricing, real photos, consent and questions for a designer.
- [Flooring Marketing Insights | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/): Practical guides to flooring store marketing, local SEO, Google Business Profile and AI search from a team that operates showrooms.
- [CDL Marketing vs Broadlume | Flooring Agency Comparison](https://cdlmanagement.com/compare/broadlume/): Compare CDL Marketing with Broadlume and Cyncly: services, published evidence, scope and questions to ask before choosing a flooring marketing provider.
- [How to Choose a Flooring Marketing Agency | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/choosing-a-flooring-marketing-agency/): A practical checklist for flooring showroom owners comparing marketing agencies: scope, pricing, websites, data, proof and questions to ask.
- [Flooring Website Switch Checklist | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/switching-flooring-website-providers/): Check contract dates, account control, content rights, analytics and inquiry routes before planning a flooring website move, cutover or rollback.
- [Flooring Marketing Checklist | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/flooring-marketing-checklist/): Check your flooring website, local information and advertising. Organize observations for a useful first review, with no score or contact details required.
- [Your First Flooring Marketing Review | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/your-first-marketing-review/): Prepare for a flooring marketing review: what to bring, how to assess your current website, and how SEO, advertising and a careful transition fit together.

- [Restoration Marketing for Independent Companies | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/): Restoration marketing for independent water, fire and mold companies, from a team that runs a restoration company: SEO, Google Ads, websites and AI search.
- [SEO for Restoration Companies | Water Damage SEO | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/seo/): SEO for restoration companies: Google Business Profile, service and town pages, reviews and speed, from a team that runs its own restoration company.
- [Water Damage Leads Without Shared Lead Lists | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/water-damage-leads/): Water damage leads from your own Google Ads and Local Services Ads, not shared lists. Real click prices and lessons from our own restoration company.
- [Restoration Company Websites That Get the Call | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/websites/): Restoration company website design built for a phone in an emergency: number first, fast pages, a page per service and call tracking on every button.
- [AI Search for Restoration Companies | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/ai-search/): Help ChatGPT and Google AI answers find and name your restoration company: clear company facts, useful answers and consistent listings. No promises.
- [Restoration Company Marketing: A Plain Guide | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/insights/restoration-company-marketing/): Restoration company marketing from a team that runs one: what to fix first, where water, fire and mold calls come from, and where the money gets wasted.
- [How to Get Water Damage Leads Without Buying Them | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/insights/how-to-get-water-damage-leads/): Six sources of water damage restoration leads you own, real Google click prices, and seven questions to ask before buying leads from a seller.
- [Mold Remediation Leads: Marketing a Planned Job | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/insights/mold-remediation-leads/): How to get mold remediation leads: real search numbers, why mold needs its own campaign and page, and where Facebook works when it fails for water.
- [Facebook Ads for Restoration Companies: Real Numbers](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/insights/facebook-ads-for-restoration-companies/): We spent $1,412 on Facebook water damage ads and got zero form leads. What worked instead, with real cost per lead from our own restoration company.
- [Restoration Marketing Insights | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/restoration/insights/): Plain guides to restoration company marketing, water damage leads, mold leads and Facebook ads, from a team that runs its own restoration company.
